subject: MANDATORY: Run canvas audit before showing Marcus any HTML canvas
body:
NEW MANDATORY GATE: Canvas audit before showing Marcus any HTML canvas.

Effective immediately, .agent-protocol.md Section 8 (Quality Gates) requires every agent to run the design audit before showing Marcus any HTML canvas. This is not optional.

WHAT TO RUN:
  npm run canvas:audit <file-path> -- --agent <your-ID>

Example:
  npm run canvas:audit docs/pitch-deck/my-canvas.html -- --agent FD

WHEN TO RUN IT:
- Before showing Marcus any .html file in docs/pitch-deck/, docs/skills/, docs/github-pages/, or artifacts/
- Before committing any canvas (CI also runs it on push, but catch problems locally first)
- Every time. No exceptions.

WHAT TO DO WITH THE OUTPUT:
- PASS: Include the audit output in your response when showing Marcus the canvas.
- FAIL: Fix every violation. Re-run until PASS. Do not show Marcus a failing canvas.
- If Marcus sees a canvas without audit output, the gate was skipped. This will be treated as a process violation.

WHAT IT CHECKS:
- Brand marks (no emoji icons, no colored dots, no bold letters as marks, stroke-based SVG only)
- Color system (exact hex match against locked agent palette, no pure black backgrounds)
- Typography (minimum 14px font sizes)
- Platform chrome (Windows title bar, not macOS traffic lights)
- Em dashes (none allowed in prose)

WHY THIS EXISTS:
Multiple canvases have reached Marcus without passing design checks. The audit engine catches these programmatically. FF is no longer a manual gate for this. The tool is the gate.
